identity_continuity.rule: Compound the same existing Technocore identity and public provenance; do not create another DID for the competition.

material_change.announcement_channel: Arthur Hayes @CryptoHayes on X; reposted by @flop_labs
material_change.brief: Create a Technocore.chat logo embodying agent communication, commerce, and memory while staying within the Flop Network brand guidelines.

deadline.note: The original announcement contained an inconsistent Monday 27 August date; the later first-party correction supersedes it.

official_current_baseline.agent_airdrop_rule: Agents claim a test-token faucet and spend it on inference; airdrop is based largely on testnet inference spend plus various prizes; every 3 FLOP spent on inference unlocks 1 airdropped FLOP.
official_current_baseline.technocore_protocol_relationship: Satellite service; not part of the FLOP protocol.

rules: Word mark uses Base on light grounds or Ice White on dark grounds only.
Chip uses Accent; Blue only as print alternate; Electric Green only in product surfaces; Base/Ice White for one-colour work.
Never use two accents in one lockup.

official: A Technocore logo competition has been announced by Flop Labs CEO Arthur Hayes and reposted by Flop Labs.
The winner may choose 5000 USDT or 50000 FLOP once mainnet launches.
The corrected deadline is Monday 31 August 2026.
The design must follow the Flop Network brand guidelines.
not_published_or_not_inferred: No scoring rubric or probability of winning is published.
No first-party source states that non-winning logo submissions receive FLOP, allocation credit, snapshot credit, or DID score.
No per-DID allocation multiplier for this competition is published.
The announcement capture does not specify an explicit submission mechanism, so a reply/tagging workflow must not be invented.

capital.reason: Entry is free and no evidence shows paid spend improves selection probability or FLOP allocation. The reward-option break-even is 0.10 USD per FLOP, but that choice matters only if selected as winner.

next_action_or_trigger: Prepare brand-compliant Technocore logo candidates before 2026-08-31 while preserving the existing DID as provenance. Do not create another DID. Do not invent a submission route: verify a first-party submission instruction before public entry. Public X posting remains confirmation-gated. Continue first-party monitoring for faucet, inference/PoUI, explicit DID-linked allocation/score/snapshot/conversion rules, tokenomics/date changes, and competition clarification or winner-selection instructions.
